text:
Rina Patel: Quick proposal / reduce scope for Optimize toolkit v1 to a tight pilot-focused MVP: adaptive batching + prefix KV cache + eval-triggered regression alerts. Drop automated quant recommendations from the runtime; supply an "advisory" doc for pilot customers. Goal: pilot in 10 days. Thoughts?

Evan Moss: Strong +1 to a tighter slice. Suggest explicit launch criteria so SRE and sales know the guardrails.

Ivy Chen: From runtime POV this is doable if we keep the admission control simple. Quant recs need sample-based eval and ingestion pipelines; bigger effort.

Omar Reyes: Customer ask: two pilots (SlateAI, DocuPilot) asked for quant recs, but will accept an experimental PDF if we clearly label limitations.

Rina Patel: OK Omar to own the advisory doc. We should be explicit: advisory = "best-effort, not supported, may change outputs."

Evan Moss: Proposed acceptance metrics: econ >=15% median token-cost reduction on pilot routes over 7d; p95 user latency no more than +12% vs baseline; alerting FPR <10% on seeded regression tests. If any gate fails, pause rollout for that route.

Ivy Chen: For admission control I'll propose a tiny config blob to start with:
```json
{"max_wait_ms":25,"min_batch_size":3,"route_override":false}
```
We'll run synthetic traces then a canary. Need one feature flag per-tenant.

platform-bot: Canary cluster spun up: optimize-mvp-canary (us-east-1) x3 nodes. Alerts wired to #eng-oncall. Image: registry.redwood/optimize:canary-2026-03-23

Omar Reyes: I will draft the advisory and include a sample experimental quant config plus clear caveats. ETA Thu EOD.

Rina Patel: Launch gates checklist (short): 1) bench on 3 pilot prompt sets with econ delta >=15% on median, 2) seeded regression tests for alert precision and FPR <10%, 3) per-route enable toggle + playbook for rollback, 4) pilot onboarding doc + customer comms.

Evan Moss: Also add an early-usage business rule: measure the first 72 hours; if econ improvement <8% on a route, automatically disable batching for that route and notify owners.

Ivy Chen: I'll run the infra spike and post results here. Need a small telemetry tag to correlate before/after for each route.

Rina Patel: Decision: MVP = adaptive batching + prefix cache + eval alerts. Quantization recommendations = advisory doc only, not runtime. Action owners: Ivy infra spike, Evan acceptance checklist, Omar advisory, Rina coordinates pilot. Aim: pilot rollout in ~10 days. :rocket:
